predictions: Ok, I'm at a loss. I don't know how I can keep getting picks wrong for the same teams over and over and over. It doesn't matter who they play, who I pick, where they play, who attends or doesn't, I just get the picks wrong. I'm 2-8 in Main Street Mayhem matches, 2-8 in Cheap Shots matches, and 3-7 in Bright Side of Flights matches. I'm at 178-82 (68.5% correct) for the season, so I've gotten 28% of my wrong picks for the season with just that 5.6% of the teams. That's kinda nutso.

Match of the week: (G Div.) 21 Dart Salute @ Flight Club. Two weeks ago, Salute was undefeated and cruising to the G title. My oh my, how the last two weeks have flipped that script. Not only is Salute now sporting two losses, but they are also now looking up at tonight's opponent. I have been spouting off about Flight Club's superb DCkt formula for weeks, and here it makes the difference again. Club, 13-11.

Match #2: (B Div.) Village Idiots @ Wing & a Plaque. The B race has become a wonderfully messy four-team melee, with those four separated by only one loss and a handful of points. How the Idiots are in this despite losing records in both cricket sets, I'm not sure, but here they are. That certainly leaves me picking Wing in this one though, 14-10.

Match #3: (A Div.) Show Me Your Tips @ Dart Vader. One of two things is going to happen here… Show Me is going to win and drop A to a two-team title race. Or… Vader is going to win, keep their own title hopes very much alive, and hope for a little help from Show Me later. Man, Vader is soooo good. But Show Me just seems to have really pieced things together just right. I'll go with Show Me, 13-11.

Match #4: (D Div.) Bottoms Up @ Menace 2 Sobriety. Menace is just so hard to figure out. I never know who is going to miss a night, whether they'll really show up at the line, etc. But they are 7-3 and right behind the lead duo (after losing to the second place team last week). Now the first place team is in the way too. Bottoms, 14-10.

Match #5: (C Div.) Liquor Possee @ Nine Lives. This pair was tied for first and only one match back of first before last week. Now one of them will lose a second straight, and title hopes could be vanishing. Things move fast in C. Let's gamble that Possee all shows up, 14-10.

Match #6: (D Div.) Main Street Mayhem @ Duck Fook. I always get Mayhem picks wrong. Even if I think there might be attendance issues coloring the pick. This might be the Ducks' last chance at being in the race for a top-two spot finish. I'll take the Ducks, 14-10.

Match #7: (F Div.) Heart of Dartness @ Death Throw. A win here for Dartness won't technically clinch F because Nein Mark could still be mathematically alive, but this is really about whether or not Dartness can remain undefeated. They do, but just barely, 13-11.

Match #8: (E Div.) Dart Knights @ Ton 80 Proof. Ton 80 has now taken two straight losses after starting 8-0, and now their title hopes hang on by a thread. They can't afford another loss here, but the Knights present a real chance for a 3rd straight. Ton 80 Proof, 13-11.

Match #9: (A Div.) Why So Serious? @ Inconsistent Consistently. The battle for 4th in the league is heated (and is somehow also a battle to avoid a possible drop to B next season, since three teams are in a dead heat). I'm thinking Inconsistent gets payback, 13-11.

Match #10: (C Div.) Mulligan's Mafia @ Rif Raf. At first glance, this is 1st vs. next-to-last. But Rif Raf has won 3 straight, including over the #2 and #3 teams. Let's make it 4 straight! Rif Raf, 13-11!

Match #11: (E Div.) Rippin Darts @ Red-eye Rangers. Is this the first direct head-to-head to determine a bottom-2 finish this season? It's time for the weekly nailbiter Rangers to move up. Red-eye, 14-10.
Match #12: (G Div.) Shark Shooters @ Throwin' on the Bayou. Salute lost last week, but the Shooters did too and missed a chance at first. Now they face the team that beat Salute! Shooters, 13-11.
